description: Explain the model spec: a JSON tree of named parts that godot_model_build turns into a .glb. Returns plain text: the spec rules, a JSON example (a small car), then one line per ready-made kind with its parameters and their defaults. Read it before you write a `spec` or pass `params` to godot_model_build; skip it when a ready-made `kind` with its defaults is enough. godot_model_brief has a shorter cheat sheet. Read-only.
name: godot_model_spec
title: Model spec format
